sources.subject: Vitalik
sources.custody: publicly attributed personal account; sole control not established
sources.decision: Publish with source; address is resolved and labeled vitalik.eth, not a complete portfolio.

sources.subject: CZ
sources.decision: Binance explicitly describes these as custody for users. Reserve/hot-wallet addresses are not evidence of CZ personal ownership. No personal address published.

sources.subject: Asem
sources.decision: Reviewed official IMD documentation and public explorer search for Asem/address attribution; no authoritative signed/public personal-wallet binding found. A first name, launch requester or treasury account alone cannot identify Asem. No address published.

limitations: Public labels can be stale; none proves sole control. No purchased address labels, private API or guessed address was used. New labels require explicit custody classification and review.
